blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has appointed three new associate justices to the Court of Appeals (CA), filling all current vacancies in the 69-member court. In a Facebook post on Wednesday, the Presidential Communications Office said Marcos appointed Trade Undersecretary Allan Gepty; Parañaque Regional Trial Court Branch 294 Presiding Judge Leilani Marie Dacanay-Grimares; and Las Piñas RTC Executive Judge Pia Cristina Bersamin-Embuscado as new CA associate justices. Bersamin-Embuscado is the eldest daughter of former Chief Justice and Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin. This is a developing story. /mcm...
